dialogues.speaker: Moongazer Log
dialogues.text: "...It was the fall of a star..."

dialogues.speaker: Moongazer Log
dialogues.text: "...It was the soul of a star..."

dialogues.speaker: Moongazer Log
dialogues.text: "...It calls to me... as broth calls to the table..."

dialogues.speaker: Moongazer Log
dialogues.text: "...Ah, I hear you, O Ysna'qurel, Ruler of Throgg... Pitch-black darkness has swallowed you..."

dialogues.speaker: Moongazer Log
dialogues.text: "...You are me, and I am you..."
